title: Parse Zotero URLs
description: Parse Zotero library exports (Zotero RDF, Zotero CSV, CSL JSON) and emit item URLs with their titles, tags, dates, abstracts and notes as JSONL snapshot records.

PARSE_ZOTERO_URLS_ENABLED.description: Enable Zotero library export URL parsing

PARSE_ZOTERO_URLS_INCLUDE_ATTACHMENTS.description: Also import the URLs of web snapshot / linked URL attachments when they differ from their parent item's URL

PARSE_ZOTERO_URLS_DOI_FALLBACK.description: Import items that have a DOI but no URL as https://doi.org/<DOI>

PARSE_ZOTERO_URLS_COLLECTION_TAGS.description: Add the names of the Zotero collections an item belongs to as tags

PARSE_ZOTERO_URLS_ITEMTYPE_TAGS.description: Add a zotero:<itemType> tag (e.g. zotero:journalArticle) to each imported item
